name: shelfmark
description: A catalog of the physical books the owner has at home.

scripts.dev: tsc -b shared && concurrently --names server,web --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev -w @shelfmark/server" "npm run dev -w @shelfmark/web"
scripts.dev:https: tsc -b shared && concurrently --names server,web --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev -w @shelfmark/server" "SHELFMARK_HTTPS=1 npm run dev -w @shelfmark/web"
